From the shop's own official Gnavi pages (gjp0200.gorp.jp is the shop's site; the menu lives at r.gnavi.co.jp/0001442073/menu1–3), checked 2026-08-20. This is Hokkaido jingisukan done on an 網 wire grill rather than the usual domed skillet, with lamb from the old Sapporo butcher 肉の山本. Three dipping sauces come with the raw-lamb cuts: the house 秘伝のタレ, Yamamoto-san's own tare, and a yuzu-kosho grated-ponzu. All three are soy-based.

items.en: Top-grade lamb shoulder loin — the shop's signature: tender, marbled and genuinely scarce. Raw lamb, you grill it yourself
items.note: 肉は生のまま供されるが、3種のタレはいずれも醤油ベース。The meat arrives unseasoned — it is the three dipping sauces that carry wheat. Ask for salt and lemon and the cut itself is clean; the shared grill is still a risk.

items.en: Lamb shoulder — the shop says Yamamoto-san's shoulder is unbeatable
items.note: 生肉、タレは醤油ベース。Unseasoned raw lamb; the tare is the wheat. Ask for salt.

items.ja: シャトーブリアン（ヒレ）
items.en: Lamb chateaubriand — the fillet, only a tiny amount off each animal; the shop calls it the phantom cut
items.note: 生肉、タレは醤油ベース。Unseasoned raw lamb; ask for salt instead of the tare.

items.en: Lamb rump — the lean cut from hip to tail, still soft
items.note: 生肉、タレは醤油ベース。Unseasoned raw lamb; ask for salt.

items.ja: スプリングラムチョップ＜1本＞
items.en: Spring lamb chop — a 3-to-6-month-old lamb, rare and juicy. Cooked for you in the kitchen rather than at your table
items.note: 厨房で調理して提供されるため味付けが未記載。This one is cooked in the kitchen, so the seasoning is out of your hands — ask what goes on it.

items.en: Marinated lamb loin — pre-seasoned in the house tare. The shop warns it will cost you both extra drinks and extra rice
items.section: 【羊肉】味付けジンギスカン Marinated lamb
items.note: 味付け＝特製ダレ又はピリ辛旨ダレ、いずれも醤油ベース。Already marinated in a soy-based tare — there is no unseasoned version of this cut.

items.en: Marinated mutton loin — the connoisseur's cut; the shop insists the freshness means no muttony smell
items.section: 【羊肉】味付けジンギスカン Marinated lamb
items.note: 味付け＝醤油ベースのタレ。Pre-marinated in soy tare.

items.en: Top shoulder loin marinated in a crock — a limited daily quantity, gone when it is gone
items.section: 【羊肉】味付けジンギスカン Marinated lamb
items.note: 壷漬けの漬けダレ＝醤油ベース。Crock-marinated in soy tare. 売切御免 — limited.

items.en: Marinated lamb short rib — the fatty middle cut
items.note: 味付け＝醤油ベース。Pre-marinated in soy tare.

items.en: Marinated lamb liver — the shop pairs it with the spring-onion salt tare
items.note: 味付け＝醤油ベース。Pre-marinated. Even the ネギ塩ダレ it is served with usually carries soy.

items.en: Lamb heart — a genuinely unusual thing to find on a grill
items.note: 味付けの有無が未記載。The menu does not say whether it is pre-seasoned — ask.

items.en: Lamb tongue — the shop calls the crunch the peak of the whole menu
items.note: 味付けの有無が未記載。Seasoning unstated — ask for it plain with salt.

items.en: Lamb and gyoja-ninniku (Hokkaido wild garlic) sausage, one
items.note: ソーセージの結着材・調味料が未記載。Sausage binders commonly carry wheat — ask.

items.en: Grilled leek
items.note: 野菜そのままを焼く、味付けなし。Raw vegetable brought to the table to grill yourself, unseasoned. Keep it off the part of the grill where marinated lamb has been and away from the tare bowl.

items.en: Grilled onion
items.note: 野菜そのまま、味付けなし。Plain raw onion to grill. Same shared-grill caveat.

items.en: Grilled asparagus
items.note: 野菜そのまま、味付けなし。Plain raw asparagus to grill.

items.en: Grilled king oyster mushroom
items.note: きのこそのまま、味付けなし。Plain raw mushroom to grill.

items.en: The house stir-fried vegetables — filed under 裏番長, 'the boss behind the scenes'. The shop says you absolutely must order it. Cooked in the kitchen
items.note: 炒め調味は醤油ベース、ジンギスカンのタレを使うのが定番。Stir-fried in the same soy tare the lamb uses; usually cooked with lamb fat.

items.ja: ラム麻辣しゃぶしゃぶ
items.en: Lamb in numbing mala broth — hot, tingling and rich. Cooked for you
items.note: 麻辣スープの豆板醤・甜麺醤に小麦。Mala broth is built on doubanjiang and sweet bean paste, both wheat-containing.

items.en: Lamb gyoza — eaten with Yamamoto's tare cut with chilli miso
items.note: 餃子の皮＝小麦、タレも醤油。Wheat wrapper and soy tare.

items.en: Pork offal in miso — a standard at Hokkaido jingisukan houses, and the shop's own recommendation. Filed as 東千歳の味, the taste of Higashi-Chitose
items.note: 味噌ダレの味噌種別が未記載。Miso tare — ask which miso, since a 麦味噌 would be barley, and most horumon miso tare also carries soy.

items.en: Imo-mochi with butter — the Hokkaido potato cake, chewy and browned
items.note: いも餅は馬鈴薯澱粉が基本だが、市販品は小麦粉入りのものもある。Imo-mochi is normally potato and potato starch, but shop-bought versions sometimes contain wheat flour — ask. Butter, so not vegan.

items.en: Chips
items.note: 共用フライヤーで羊肉餃子等を揚げる可能性。Fried in the same oil as the gyoza and the karaage — cross-contact.

items.en: Salted green soybeans in the pod
items.note: 塩茹でのみ。Salt-boiled pods, nothing added — the safest thing on the table for a coeliac.

items.en: Raw cabbage tossed with salted kelp
items.note: 塩昆布は醤油で炊いた製品が大半。Shio-konbu is nearly always simmered in soy before drying — ask, but assume wheat unless told otherwise.

items.en: Spicy cucumber
items.note: 和えダレが未記載、ごま油＋醤油が定番。Dressing unpublished; sesame oil and soy is the usual formula — ask.

items.en: Kimchi
items.note: 市販キムチは魚醤・アミ塩辛入りが一般的、調味料に小麦の場合も。Commercial kimchi normally contains fish sauce or salted shrimp, and the seasoning may carry wheat — ask.

items.en: House-pickled mountain yam
items.note: 漬け地が未記載、醤油漬けが定番。Pickling liquor unpublished; yam is usually pickled in soy — ask.

items.en: A whole pickled cucumber on a stick
items.note: 漬け地が未記載。Pickling liquor unpublished — ask.

items.ja: オールドファッションサラダ
items.en: Old-fashioned salad — ten ingredients, in the Showa Western-diner style
items.note: ドレッシングとハム類が未記載。Dressing and the cold-cut components are unpublished; mayonnaise is likely.

items.ja: パクチー好きのサラダ
items.en: The coriander-lover's salad — the shop pitches it as the thing to eat between mouthfuls of lamb
items.note: ドレッシングが未記載。Dressing unpublished — ask, or ask for oil and salt.

items.en: Potato salad with cod roe
items.note: マヨネーズ（卵）とたらこの調味液。Mayonnaise plus roe cured in a soy/sake liquor — ask.

items.en: Lamb yakisoba — the shop's recommended way to finish, and the closer on the full course
items.note: 焼きそば麺＝小麦、ソースも小麦。Wheat noodles and a wheat sauce.

items.ja: 道産子 卵かけご飯
items.en: Hokkaido raw-egg rice, with a knob of rich Hokkaido butter
items.note: 卵かけご飯には醤油をかけるのが前提。TKG is defined by the soy you pour on it — ask for it without and it is rice, egg and butter. Dairy.

items.ja: 道産子 山わさび飯
items.en: Horseradish rice — grated yama-wasabi over rice, the Hokkaido staple. Addictive, and cheap
items.note: 山わさび飯は醤油をかけて食べる。Yama-wasabi rice is eaten with soy poured over — without it, rice and grated horseradish would be clean. Ask.

items.en: Grilled rice ball, one
items.note: 焼きおにぎりは醤油を塗って焼く。Brushed with soy before grilling.

items.en: Plain white rice — small ¥200, medium ¥280, large ¥380
items.note: 白飯のみ、調味なし。Plain steamed rice, nothing added.

items.ja: 白玉きなこアイスクリーム
items.en: Ice cream with glutinous rice dumplings and roasted soy flour
items.note: 白玉＝もち米粉、きなこ＝大豆で穀物の小麦は使わないが、市販アイスの安定剤が未記載。Shiratama is glutinous rice flour and kinako is soybean — neither is wheat — but the ice cream's own ingredients are unpublished. Dairy.

items.en: Rum and raisin ice cream — the closer on the full lamb course
items.note: 市販アイスの原材料が未記載。Commercial ice cream, ingredients unpublished. Dairy.

items.en: Beginner's course, 7 dishes — top shoulder loin, lamb loin, mutton loin, Hokkaido ramen salad, crock-marinated top shoulder, chips, the house stir-fried vegetables, and a finish of cod-roe-and-horseradish rice with egg soup. ¥3,980 food only, ¥5,480 with 2h free-flow including draught beer
items.note: ラーメンサラダの麺＝小麦、タレ類＝醤油、山わさび飯も醤油。The ramen salad is wheat noodles, the tare are soy, and the rice finish is soy-dressed. Two people minimum; 17:00–23:00. Add ¥1,500 for free-flow to the food-only price.

items.en: Veteran's course, 7 dishes — top shoulder loin and shoulder, then the rare cuts (marinated short rib, tongue, heart), pork horumon in miso, the house stir-fried vegetables, marinated lamb and mutton loin, lamb yakisoba to finish, rum-raisin ice cream. ¥4,500 food only, ¥6,000 with 2h free-flow
items.note: 焼きそば＝小麦、味付け肉と味噌ダレ＝醤油。Yakisoba is wheat; the marinated cuts and miso tare are soy. Two people minimum. Add ¥1,500 for free-flow.

items.en: Sapporo Black Label draught, medium. Also どでか！ ¥890 and 筋トレ！ (the arm-workout size) ¥1,190
items.note: 麦芽＝大麦。Barley malt.

items.en: Hokkaido melon sour, made with red-flesh melon purée — the shop's pick
items.note: ベース焼酎の種類が未記載。Base shochu unpublished — ask it is not a barley shochu. Upsize +¥220.

items.en: Guarana sour — guarana soda being the Hokkaido soul drink. The shop's pick
items.note: ベース焼酎の種類が未記載。Base shochu unpublished. Upsize +¥220.

items.en: Haskap sour, made with Hokkaido haskap berry syrup
items.note: ベース焼酎の種類が未記載。Base shochu unpublished.

items.ja: りんごのほっぺサワー
items.en: Apple sour, made with Yoichi apple juice
items.note: ベース焼酎の種類が未記載。Base shochu unpublished.

items.en: Corn-tea highball, made with Hokkaido sweetcorn tea
items.note: コーン茶自体は麦茶ではなくとうもろこし。The tea is corn, not barley — but the base shochu is unpublished, so ask.

items.en: Hoppy, white or black — the beer-flavoured mixer you cut with shochu. ¥550 the set, ¥200 for a refill of shochu, ¥350 for another bottle
items.note: ホッピーは麦芽を使ったビールテイスト飲料。Hoppy is brewed from barley malt — the low alcohol does not change that.

items.en: The tavern lemon sour. Also 最強 ¥550, 丸搾り ¥480, 蜂蜜 ¥480, 旨塩 ¥480
items.note: ベース焼酎の種類が未記載。Base shochu unpublished. Refill chuhai ¥200.

items.en: Rum highball — the shop's pick, and the pun is deliberate at a lamb restaurant
items.note: ラムはサトウキビ由来で穀物不使用。Rum is distilled from sugar cane, not grain — unusually for a highball list, this one has no cereal in it at all. ラムコーク ¥480 likewise.

items.ja: 悟大ハイボール（ブラックニッカスペシャル）
items.en: The house highball, on Black Nikka Special

items.en: Yoichi highball — the Hokkaido single malt
items.note: シングルモルト＝大麦麦芽。Single malt is malted barley.

items.en: Kurokirishima sweet-potato shochu, by the glass
items.note: 芋焼酎でも麹に米か麦を使う。Sweet-potato base, but the koji grain is unpublished — ask.

items.en: Nikaido barley shochu, by the glass
